title: What does each bit of a plant do?
_map: Parts of a plant (Y1). Big idea: roots, stem, leaves and flowers each have a job. Creative: design a plant for a strange place (a cave, the desert).
_story: Steve planted a flower and wants to know what each bit is for. Ismaeel taps each part to find its job, then designs a plant for a desert.
_stepChain: a plant has parts → each part has a job: roots drink and hold, stem carries and holds up, leaves make food from sunlight, flowers make seeds → Steve thinks leaves are only decoration → design a plant for a strange place

talk.goodAnswer: they hold the plant in the ground and drink water from the soil.

talk.ask: What would a desert plant need?
talk.goodAnswer: something like long roots to find water, thick leaves or stem to store it, or spikes so animals don't eat it.

handsOn: Pull up a weed (with permission!) and find its roots, stem and leaves. Then draw a plant for a strange place, like the moon or under the sea.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Look, Ismaeel! I grew a flower! But what are all these bits for? Tap each part, and find out its job!

parts.label: Roots
parts.narration: Roots grow down, down into the soil. They hold the plant tight, so it doesn't fall over. And they slurp up water, like straws! Slurp!

parts.label: Stem
parts.narration: The stem holds the plant up tall, and carries the water all the way up from the roots to the leaves.

parts.label: Leaves
parts.narration: Leaves catch sunshine, and use it to make food for the plant! That's why they spread out wide, like hands reaching for the sun.

parts.label: Flower
parts.narration: The flower makes seeds, so new plants can grow. Its bright colours call the bees to come and help! Buzz!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I'm going to snip off all the leaves. They're only there to look pretty!

question.prompt: Will the plant be OK without its leaves?
question.onRight: Yes, you remembered! Leaves make the plant's food from sunshine.

0.hint: What do the leaves do with sunshine?
0.say: Leaves catch sunshine and make the plant's food! Without them, the plant would go hungry, and droop.

question.reveal: No leaves, no food! Keep the leaves, Steve!

narration.text: Now design a plant for a really strange place! In a hot desert, there's hardly any water. What would your plant's roots need to do? And its leaves? Draw it, and tell a grown-up!

rule.text: Roots drink. Stem carries. Leaves make food. Flowers make seeds.
rule.ask: What does each part of a plant do? Say it out loud! Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Roots hold the plant and drink water. The stem holds it up and carries water. Leaves make food from sunlight. Flowers make seeds.

bonus.prompt: Bonus! A cactus has spikes instead of leaves. Why might that help in the desert?
bonus.reveal: Both! Spikes lose less water than big leaves. And ouch! They stop thirsty animals from eating it.
